create_config_edgetam_video: create an EdgeTamVideoConfig instance with default vision, prompt encoder, and mask decoder sub-configs
build_config_sub_configs: build an EdgeTamVideoConfig with explicit EdgeTamVisionConfig, EdgeTamVideoPromptEncoderConfig, and EdgeTamVideoMaskDecoderConfig sub-configs
create_prompt_encoder_config: create an EdgeTamVideoPromptEncoderConfig with custom hidden_size, image_size, patch_size, and mask_input_channels
create_mask_decoder_config: create an EdgeTamVideoMaskDecoderConfig with custom mlp_dim, attention_downsample_rate, and num_multimask_outputs
initialize_config_from_dict: initialize an EdgeTamVideoConfig from a dictionary of keyword arguments including vision_config, prompt_encoder_config, and mask_decoder_config
